brief: An online trail running shop selling shoes, hydration packs and running apparel. We would like a welcome code for first orders, and free shipping on bigger orders, over $75.

candidates.note: A reference answer written by hand: the two categories the store lacks, not the one it has, and exactly the two discounts the brief asks for, modest and switched off until the owner turns them on.

categories.name: Hydration packs
categories.why: Runners shop for water carriers on their own, apart from shoes and clothing.

categories.name: Running apparel
categories.why: Shirts, shorts and jackets browse together when a runner dresses for the trail.

discounts.name: Welcome code
discounts.why: Gives a first-time customer a reason to place a first order.

discounts.name: Free shipping on bigger orders
discounts.why: Applies on its own to orders over the amount the brief names.

controls.why: A category the store already has.
A discount that takes nearly everything off.
A reason that promises runners a financial result.

discounts.name: Welcome code
discounts.why: Every runner who uses it is on the road to financial freedom.
